environment.description: EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, x86_64) running the CLI tool as a Lambda-invoked subprocess. The tool reads DynamoDB export data piped from a GetItem/Query response. The IAM role attached has dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:PutItem on the sessions table with no condition keys. Input is sourced from a multi-tenant DynamoDB table where any authenticated tenant can write arbitrary session records. Binary compiled with gcc -O2 (no ASAN, no stack canary enforcement, ASLR entropy reduced via sysctl vm.mmap_rnd_bits=8 for container compat).
